top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 proposal most compellingly couples a defined, mature physiological discovery with an exceptionally broad and sustained transformation of treatment for diabetes and obesity. A physiology-centered citation supports the Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker allocation while avoiding a claim to encompass the whole subsequent drug-development enterprise.
recusal_note: No connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. The profile documents approximately twenty coauthored works with fellow committee member Thomas Perlmann; this does not concern the proposed candidates.
